Thursday Spring Lake Ride

Tupelo, MS · Road

Thursday Spring Lake Ride is a road group ride in Tupelo, MS. It rolls every Thursday at 5:30 pm from Spring Lake Community Center. About 27.5 miles, two groups, 18–20 and 22–24 mph.

First time? Here's the drill

Bring
a helmet, front and rear lights (it's a dark-hours ride), water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before 5:30 pm. Tell whoever's leading that you're new.
Pace
Expect 22–24 mph: fast — for riders who race or train. It splits into pace groups. Pick the slowest one your first time; you can move up next week.
Check
Look at the host's website the day of — that's where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the Thursday Spring Lake Ride group ride

A 27.5-mile Thursday ride. The first 10 miles are casual, then it splits into an 18 to 20 mph group and a 22 to 24 mph group. Everyone rejoins for the last 7 miles.
